name: 22 St John Street
summary: A Grade II listed Georgian terrace in Manchester's legal quarter, restored as characterful workspace with original fireplaces, sash windows and a landscaped rear courtyard — launched to the market in August 2026 and now letting.

name: Barnett House
address: Barnett House, 53 Fountain Street, Manchester M2
summary: Barnett House at 53 Fountain Street, being repositioned as Tabula — flexible, high-quality workspace in central Manchester, currently in design development ahead of a start on site.

name: Hazelgate
address: Hazelgate (former Chester House), London Road, Hazel Grove, Stockport
summary: The transformation of the former Chester House, approaching practical completion as Hazelgate — an exclusive collection of beautifully designed apartments in the vibrant centre of Hazel Grove, now for sale.

name: Barrington House
summary: A completed collection of thoughtfully designed residences in the heart of Altrincham, pairing architectural restraint with its market-town setting — now letting by the room and by the apartment.

name: The Courthouse
summary: An elegant conversion of the former Macclesfield courthouse on Hibel Road — thirteen one and two-bedroom apartments in the heart of the bustling market town, now selling.

name: Davenport Park
summary: A completed residential development beside Davenport station, delivering homes with direct rail links into Manchester Piccadilly.
